mapping_source: Verified stored LeRobot ranges, upstream new_calib midpoint convention; gripper closed reference and physical encoder angle resolution. Absolute optical metrology not performed.
notes: Bounded unloaded joint tests, not a full workspace or pick-and-place validation.
Encoder agreement is not an independent measurement of absolute link angles.
One earlier health assertion aborted without diagnostic capture; it did not recur in the recorded complete run.
Existing servo gains and dead zones were preserved; no EEPROM writes.
